description: This is a house under Part 9. How far can an occupant travel inside the house to reach an exit?

must_not_cite.why: That is a Part 3 travel-distance number, not the Part 9 limit.
The Part 9 travel distance is Sentence 9.9.8.2.(1).

description: A Part 3 building. Which provision decides that sprinklers are required, as distinct from how a sprinkler system is installed?

must_not_cite.prohibited_use: as the provision that decides sprinklers are required
must_not_cite.why: Whether sprinklers are required comes from the 3.2.2 classification article together with Sentence 3.2.2.18.(1).
Sentence 9.10.1.3.(8) only points to Section 3.2.5. It does not decide that sprinklers are required.

description: Where is the exit from this suite? Do not treat a room-egress rule, or a rule about openings beside an exterior exit stair, as the exit.

must_not_cite.why: Article 9.9.4.4. is openings near exterior exit stairs.
Article 3.3.1.5. is room and suite egress, not the exit.
Article 9.9.7.4. is room and suite egress, not the exit.

description: An office suite, not a dwelling, needs a second way out of the suite. Which egress provision applies to this occupancy?

must_not_cite.prohibited_use: as egress for an occupancy other than a dwelling unit
must_not_cite.why: Article 9.9.9.1. applies to dwelling units only.

description: A sprinklered Group C residential building under Part 3. Which building classification article applies? Do not use a reserved article number.

must_not_cite.prohibited_use: as the sprinklered Group C classification
must_not_cite.why: Article 3.2.2.50. is Reserved. Sprinklered Group C is Article 3.2.2.51.

description: A house with no dwelling above another, beside a property line. Which spatial-separation subsection applies, and which sentence decides that?

must_not_cite.prohibited_use: as the spatial-separation subsection for a building Sentence 9.10.15.1.(1) places under the house subsection
must_not_cite.why: Subsection 9.10.14 or 9.10.15 depends on the building type in Sentence 9.10.15.1.(1).

description: A fire separation is required between two dwelling units in the same house. Which article is the separation between dwelling units?

must_not_cite.prohibited_use: as the separation between dwelling units
must_not_cite.why: Between dwelling units, cite Article 9.10.9.16., not Article 9.10.9.15.

description: A Part 9 house. What fire-resistance rating applies to the floor assembly?
What rise and run are permitted for a stair in a house?
